description: Celebrate your love for space exploration with Rothco’s NASA Worm Logo Low Profile Cap, featuring the iconic retro NASA worm logo, which has been reinstated as an official secondary logo. This rugged cap is crafted from lightweight brushed cotton twill, providing a soft and resilient feel that's perfect for everyday wear. The low profile design offers a modern fit, while the internal sweatband ensures superior comfort by preventing sweat from running into your eyes. Top ventilation holes allow heat to escape, keeping you cool even on the warmest days. With an adjustable hook and loop strap closure, this cap fits most head sizes comfortably. The front panel is reinforced with buckram, giving the hat structure and integrity, so it maintains its shape over time. Whether you're a space enthusiast or just looking for a cool, comfortable cap, Rothco’s NASA Worm Logo Low Profile Cap is the perfect choice to show your admiration for NASA and space exploration. Keep your head in the game with Rothco’s collection of headwear and accessories. Designed with precision and purpose, our headgear is built to withstand the harshest conditions. Whether you’re tackling the cold in one of our Watch Caps or Balaclavas, or out on a mission in a Boonie Hat or Fatigue Cap, our diverse range of headwear provides unmatched comfort and protection for everyone from military personnel to outdoor enthusiasts.
